events.context: Introduce skincare products starting with sensitive skin Vitamin C series, detailing product interpretation, target audience, and texture impressions
Describe Albion EXCIA Star Bright Serum: product name, type, core ingredients (high penetration whitening, hidden flower pigment complex, NMN), interpretation, audience, texture

Describe PASS The Black Serum: product name, type, core tech (light sense with black rice ferment, island tea extract; color approaches for red/blue/yellow/tea tones), interpretation, audience, texture
Describe SK-II Genoptics Advance Essence: product name, type, ingredients (Pitera, Inositol, niacinamide, red myrrh alcohol), interpretation on spot roots and barrier, audience, texture
Describe Obagi C25 Serum Neo: product name, type, upgraded penetration tech (vertical+horizontal), iris root extract, interpretation, audience, texture
Describe Chanel Le Blanc Brightening Treatment Serum: product name, type, TXC (97x penetration tranexamic acid derivative), interpretation, audience, texture note
Describe Clé de Peau Beauté Serum Concentrate S2: product name, type, Minas Algae XGL (inhibits mTOR), 4MSK, 'continuous' and 'natural' whitening concepts, audience, texture

Describe Transino Medicinal Brightening Facial Mask upgrade: product name, type, ingredients (dipotassium glycyrrhizate, tranexamic acid, iris root), upgraded mask paper and penetration, interpretation, audience, usage
Offer selection guide categorizing products by user needs: whitening core, whitening+anti-aging, sensitive skin, comprehensive care, UV repair
Narrator introduces self as 卡之助, announces topic on face brand's melt series third release: deep clean shampoo & conditioner, starting Feb 7 pre-sale
Recount melt series: first as high-end launch spring 2024 (moisturizing type, 2nd in 2024 awards), second smooth type spring next year, different concepts/formulas
First commercial collab with melt third product; prior were personal shares; refer to past videos for details
Detail moisturizing shampoo ingredients (taurine/amino acid combo, repair components); smooth shampoo (lauryl glucoside, acids for smoothing curls)

Present melt deep clean shampoo: yellow design, ingredients combine prior two (primary taurine, secondary glucoside, betaines, acids, high lactic acid 7x, proteins, quaternium-52 2x, Perisea, gamma-dodecalactone)
Balanced cleaning between prior types, targets buildup, upgraded for damaged hair (perms, straightening, bleaching)
Melt deep clean conditioner: tube design, ingredients (stearyl alcohol, dimethicone, high lactic acid 3x, deep repair T components, ceramide NG, oils for flexibility)
Test on 100% real human hair swatches: shampoo mild, good foam, lotus-woody-musk scent, no slip residue
Conditioner: spreads easily, penetrates, smooth rinse, soft post-rinse
Update on melt Creamy Melt Powder: sodium bicarbonate + citric acid + cocoyl amphoacetate, plastic container; enhances shampoo cleaning
Test with powder: thorough removal, lighter hair; left swatch (conditioner) glossier, improved manageability; right (shampoo+powder) light
Conclude introduction; price deep clean shampoo 480ml 1760 yen
